FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 34/R&A Dated: 16th May, 2025
The Computer Proficiency Test for the Translator and Translator-cum-Proof
Reader (For SUVAS Cell) Recruitment Examination, 2024 (under Advertisement No.
PHC/01/2024) in respect of 166 candidates who had qualified the Written Test, was conducted
on 17th April, 2025.
Out of the 156 candidates who appeared at the Computer Proficiency Test, 148 have
qualified the test. However, in view of advertised vacancy category wise, only 133 candidates
have been shortlisted, for appearing at the next stage of the exercise i.e. Interview.
In some categories, the requisite proportion could not be fulfilled due to unavailability
of qualified candidates.
The names of the successful candidates, listed in order of their Roll Number, are
provided herewith in Annexure-I.
The Interview of these shortlisted candidates shall be conducted on 16th, 19th, 20th and
23rd June, 2025, within the premises of the Court in the following manner:
Date Reporting time Details of Candidates
16.06.2025 11:00 A.M. Candidates at Sr. No. 01 to 40 in the Annexure -I of this notice
19.06.2025 11:00 A.M. Candidates at Sr. No. 41 to 80 in the Annexure -I of this notice
20.06.2025 11:00 A.M. Candidates at Sr. No. 81 to 120 in the Annexure -I of this notice
23.06.2025 01:30 P.M. Candidates at Sr. No. 121 to 133 in the Annexure -I of this notice
The Admit Cards for the Interview shall be made available before the scheduled date,
which may be downloaded from the official website of the High Court:
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in. The shortlisted candidates may also be intimated through SMS
and e-mail on their registered mobile number and e-mail ID in this regard. Admit Card would
not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the schedule of interview and the
instructions mentioned in the Admit Card (Interview Letter). No request for change in the
schedule of Interview shall be entertained.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the Interview.
P a g e | 2
In light of the Judgment dated 15.07.2024 passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in
Civil Appeal No. 1880212017 titled Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Vichar Manch Bihar Vs. State of
Bihar, the Tanti (Tantwa) caste has been restored at Sl. No. 33 in the list of EBC, i.e.,
Extremely Backward Class (Schedule-I) category in the Bihar Gazette published by the
General Administration Deptt., Govt. of Bihar under its letter dated 12.08.2024.
Therefore, all such shortlisted candidates who had claimed SC category in their online
application on the basis of Tanti (Tatwa) caste, are directed to inform the High Court regarding
their caste / category as Tanti (Tatwa) under EBC category through a declaration form, to be
supplied at the time of interview. All such candidates will be required to submit the 'Non-
Creamy Layer' Certificate for availing benefit of reservation of EBC category on the scheduled
date of their interview. Their claim for reservation will not be valid in case of non-submission of
the 'Non-Creamy Layer' certificate. Further, the High Court shall be free to take decision on
the candidature of such candidates.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s official website regularly for
further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General
